title: Single hieratic sign, London, British Museum, EA 10051 + EA 10090 (AKU HT 71162)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Ursula Verhoeven; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 71162

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 71162; AKU grapheme I0210 (AKU GR 313). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: I12 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 245, 245 (v4p12), 245 (v4p5). Source publication of this facsimile: Verhoeven 2001. Occurrence: line 1; find place Abydos; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 16.7 x 16.2 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Spätzeit, 26. Dynastie – Argeaden". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Ursula Verhoeven. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
